raw_segments.text: Then Minerva answered, Sir, you have spoken well, and it will be much better that Telemachus
should do as you have said.
He therefore shall return with you and sleep at your house, but I must go back to give
orders to my crew and keep them in good heart.
I am the only older person among them.
The rest are all young men of Telemachus' own age, who have taken this voyage out of
friendship, so I must return to the ship and sleep there.
Moreover, tomorrow I must go to the Cawconians where I have a large sum of money long owing
As for Telemachus, now that he is your guest, send him to lay steemen in a chariot and let
one of your sons go with him.
Be pleased to also provide him with your best and fleetest horses.
